name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development

eligibility.other_conditions: Resident woman between 21 and 60 years of age. Family annual income must not exceed Rs 2.5 Lakh. Family landholding must be under 5 acres (approx 2.0 hectares).

benefits: Direct monthly cash benefit of Rs 1,250 deposited on the 10th of every month into the Aadhaar-linked DBT bank account of the beneficiary woman for nutritional support and financial independence.
documents_required: Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar Linked & DBT Enabled)
application_process: Apply at camps organized by Gram Panchayat or Municipal Ward office.
Submit Samagra ID and Aadhaar for biometric/eKYC verification.
Direct verification by Women & Child Development officer and DBT approval.
